Get awesome and lets build together!


Python AI Engineer / GenAI Backend Developer

We are looking for some fresh talents
We are looking for a Python AI Engineer / GenAI Backend Developer to join our team.
We are looking for an AI Engineer / GenAI Backend Developer with 1 to 1.5 years of experience who can build practical AI applications by combining Python backend engineering, Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI.
The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI/Flask, LLMs, RAG, LangChain or LangGraph, vector databases, REST APIs, and cloud platforms. They should be comfortable building AI-powered applications, integrating APIs and tools, and developing reliable backend services.


Key Areas

Agentic AI: AI agents, basic LangGraph workflows, tool calling, and agent workflows
Generative AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, context management, and basic AI evaluation
RAG: Document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and vector databases
Backend: Python, FastAPI/Flask, REST APIs, OOP, and clean coding practices
Cloud: Basic experience with AWS or other cloud platforms
Databases: PostgreSQL/MySQL, NoSQL basics, and familiarity with vector databases
Engineering: Docker, Git/GitHub, unit testing, debugging, logging, and API development
AI-Assisted Development: Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding tools


What We're Looking For

We're looking for engineers who can build and debug practical GenAI applications, not just understand AI terminology. You should have a strong foundation in Python and backend development, along with practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, embeddings, and AI agents. You should be willing to learn new AI technologies and work across backend and GenAI components. Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, learning ability, and ownership are essential. We also value developers who use AI coding assistants to improve productivity while taking full ownership of the code, testing, security, and technical decisions.


Experience

1 to 2 years


Positions

2
